Uses of Package
io.webagent4j.action

Packages that use io.webagent4j.action
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.action.internal
 
io.webagent4j.action.policy
Action authorization: IActionPolicy governs whether one action's backend side effect may proceed, evaluated by the action pipeline strictly before the backend is ever invoked.
io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.
